title: Workflow changed, then data sent to a new webhook domain
description: An automation workflow was updated and shortly after an outbound webhook went to a domain NEXORA never sent to before: automation may have been changed to exfiltrate data.

mitre.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration Over Webhook

false_positives: A legitimate new integration set up right after editing a workflow.
tuning: Review the domain; keep a list of approved integration domains and add them as a not_in condition.
